prompts.sapper-3d-style-v1.png: Style-transfer edit of the supplied Sapper turnaround. Produce one landscape character modelling reference sheet in the visual style of a high-quality sculpted 3D game character rendered in a neutral studio. Preserve the exact character identity, rugged mature face, short grey hair, exaggerated believable anatomy, olive military greatcoat, khaki scarf, leather harness, pouches, backpack, satchel and cable spool, boots, and separate wood-stock carbine with sling. Preserve the composition: full-body straight FRONT T-pose on left, matching exact SIDE PROFILE facing right on right, and isolated horizontal gun beneath, no hands on gun. Front arms fully straight horizontal shoulder height, palms down; side shows the SAME T-pose with arms foreshortened toward/away from camera. Match scale and align head and feet. Make the medium unmistakably a polished 3D model render: coherent sculpted volumes, clean geometry, physically based matte fabric, worn leather and metal, subtle surface roughness, soft studio shading and ambient occlusion, crisp edges. No painted brushwork, no illustration texture, no toy proportions. Keep clothing details and folds rather than simplifying to primitives. White background, no text or grid, no UI, no floor, no watermark. All subjects fully in frame.
prompts.sapper-wireframe-style-v1.png: Style-transfer edit: turn this exact Sapper 3D character reference sheet into a clean WIREFRAME MODELLING REFERENCE illustration. Preserve the exact front and side full-body T-pose silhouettes, face identity, all clothing and equipment forms, proportions, layout, and the separate horizontal gun beneath. The front faces the viewer with arms straight horizontal; the exact side faces right with arms foreshortened toward/away from camera in the same T-pose. Show LIGHT GREY untextured clay surfaces covered by crisp thin DARK GRAPHITE polygon mesh edges, clearly visible evenly spaced mostly quad topology flowing around the face, eyes, mouth, ears, fingers, shoulders, elbows, coat folds, pouches, backpack, trousers and boots. Gun and sling must also have clean visible polygon wire topology, straight aligned barrel. Use moderate mesh density: readable quadrilateral cells, denser loops at facial features and joints, not random crosshatching, not decorative netting. Opaque surfaces with visible surface wire edges only, avoid confusing x-ray back-face lines. Remove ALL colour textures, camouflage, fabric pattern, dirt texture and painterly brushwork: monochrome grey shaded wireframe viewport appearance. White background. No text, labels, software UI, rig bones, grid, frames, shadows on ground, checkerboard or watermark. Nothing cropped. This is an illustrative topology concept, not a claimed real mesh extraction.
